006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.AbstractCodedMetapathException;
009
010public class UnidentifiedFunctionError
011    extends AbstractCodedMetapathException {
012
013  /**
014   * the serial version UID.
015   */
016  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
017
018  /**
019   * Constructs a new Metapath exception with the provided {@code message} and
020   * {@code cause}.
021   *
022   * @param message
023   *          the exception message
024   * @param cause
025   *          the original exception cause
026   */
027  public UnidentifiedFunctionError(String message, Throwable cause) {
028    super(0, message, cause);
029  }
030
031  /**
032   * Constructs a new Metapath exception with the provided {@code message} and no
033   * cause.
034   *
035   * @param message
036   *          the exception message
037   */
038  public UnidentifiedFunctionError(String message) {
039    super(0, message);
040  }
041
042  /**
043   * Constructs a new Metapath exception with a {@code null} message and the
044   * provided {@code cause}.
045   *
046   * @param cause
047   *          the original exception cause
048   */
049  public UnidentifiedFunctionError(Throwable cause) {
050    super(0, cause);
051  }
052
053  @Override
054  public String getCodePrefix() {
055    return "FOER";
056  }
057
058}
